title: 第七章 幽林毒瘴 狼妖逞凶第八章 白骨幻形 色惑道心
content_zh:
辞黄沙旧墟，四神身负天帝余泽，联袂西行。行逾数里，地势陡然低陷，眼前横亘一片古林，名曰落魂林。
林中古木参天，虬枝盘绕，浓荫蔽日，虽白昼亦幽暗如昏夜。林间湿秽之气郁结不散，腐叶朽枝层层堆积，隐隐有淡紫瘴雾自草丛石隙间袅袅腾升，随风漫溢。此瘴触肤则灼痛钻骨，入鼻则神昏气乱，非寻常山岚毒雾可比，分明是妖物盘踞经年，以自身妖元糅合荒冢亡魂戾气所化，阴毒诡谲，足以困仙迷神。
宁洋北止步敛神，眉宇微凝，周身青木灵气悠然流转，护住周身经脉神魂，缓声道：“此林毒瘴阴冽蚀骨，乱人心志，绝非天然浊气。必有大妖潜居林中，借瘴设险，截杀行旅，祸及四方。”
王学南垂眸掐指推演卦象，片刻抬首，神色凝重：“落魂林乃西荒著名险隘，林中瘴气凝千年妖力，沾之则魂魄摇荡、修为溃散。观此瘴气氤氲之势，林中之妖道行深沉，凶威犹在先前骨妖王之上，不可轻敌。”
陈学西按紧腰间白虎利刃，身姿如苍松峙立，眸光冷冽如寒星，穿透层层紫瘴，直窥林心幽暗之处，沉声道：“妖物匿于瘴雾，藏头缩尾，只敢以毒暗算，非正道妖修行径。有本事便现出身形，当面一战，何必鬼鬼祟祟。”
张忠东手握火焰灵杖，杖尖朱雀圣火隐隐腾跃，一缕烈焰吐出，周遭近身毒瘴遇火便滋滋消融，他性情刚烈，慨然朗道：“我等本负救世天命，又得天帝仙力加持，何须畏惧林间毒瘴妖孽！索性直闯密林，斩除祸根，扫清西行前路便是。”
宁洋北微微颔首，定下调度：“瘴气剧毒，弥散无定，万万不可分散。我以青木生机清气笼罩四人身周，护持神魂经脉，隔绝毒侵；学南展玄武灵伞，固守周身屏障，挡瘴气乱流；忠东以朱雀圣火在前开路，焚瘴清道；学西游走左右，戒备暗处妖物突袭，四人步步相随，同进同退。”
三人闻言，皆肃然从命，即刻各守其位，缓缓步入落魂林中。
越往林深处行，天光愈暗，紫瘴愈发浓郁，五步之外景物尽被雾霭遮蔽，难辨山石草木。林间死寂沉沉，不闻禽鸣虫语，唯有四人步履踏过腐叶的轻响，在幽寂之中格外清晰。
忽闻林间深处，一声狼嚎陡起，凄厉苍凉，穿林裂雾，回荡山谷。嚎声未落，林间草木簌簌摇晃，一股浓烈腥风裹挟毒瘴扑面而来。数十道灰黑暗影自紫雾中疾窜而出，身形似狼，直立行走，獠牙森白外露，双眼泛着幽幽绿光，皮毛间萦绕缕缕毒瘴，正是常年受林中妖气浸染而成的毒狼妖。
群狼妖目露凶芒，龇牙低吼，不待片刻迟疑，便张牙舞爪直扑四人而来，爪尖淬满瘴毒，招招直取咽喉要害，凶悍蛮横，悍不畏死。
陈学西见状，不待妖物近身，身形骤然如离弦之箭掠出，白虎利刃应声出鞘，寒光森然划破瘴雾。他身法迅捷飘忽，穿梭群狼之间，不贪多杀，每一刀皆精准劈向狼妖头颅骨节要害。刃光起落之间，数头冲在最前的毒狼妖应声瘫倒，筋骨碎裂，再难扑跃。
然狼妖数量繁多，前仆后继，毫无惧意，余下群妖绕开陈学西，转而扑向玄武灵伞护持之内的三人。毒爪接连抓挠在灵光屏障之上，发出沉闷撞击之声，灵伞灵光随之明暗起伏，隐隐震颤。
张忠东见状，不愿任由群妖围困，当即挥动火焰灵杖，熊熊朱雀圣火奔涌而出，化作连片火浪席卷而去。圣火乃天地至阳之气，专克阴毒妖物，火浪过处，近身狼妖周身瘴气瞬间被焚散，躯体焦灼惨叫。
可妖物尸身倒地之后，伤口溢出黑紫毒血，渗入林间泥土，转瞬便蒸腾化作更浓瘴雾，周遭毒氛愈发炽烈，隐隐有合围裹笼四人之势。
王学南见状连忙高声警示：“不可肆意屠戮！此妖尸毒血能滋养瘴气，越杀瘴越盛，久困之下，我等必为毒瘴所困，得不偿失！”
宁洋北当即沉声传令：“学西、忠东，即刻收招退守，入阵固守，暂且避其锋芒，勿再妄伤群狼。”
二人闻令，立时收刃敛火，身形一晃退回灵伞护罩之内，凝神戒备。群狼妖见四人不再主动出击，也不敢贸然强攻，只远远围在瘴雾边缘，龇牙低吼，死死把守林间要道，俨然是在为林中大妖把守门户。
僵持片刻，密林深处忽然传出一道阴冷狂笑，声似狼嚎夹杂人言，粗戾霸道，震得林间枝叶簌簌落尽：“何方小辈神君，不知天高地厚，竟敢擅闯本座落魂林，还敢伤我麾下狼众，真是活得不耐烦了！”
笑声落处，氤氲紫瘴向两边缓缓分开，一道魁梧身影缓步踏出雾中。

来者人身狼首，通体覆着灰黑长毛，肩背隆起，体魄雄健可怖，森白獠牙自唇角探出，眼瞳泛着碧绿凶光，身披兽骨拼接的重甲，手中横持一杆长牙长枪，枪尖萦绕盘旋着紫黑剧毒瘴气，周身妖气滔天翻滚，威压沉沉压落，远非先前骨妖王所能比拟。正是落魂林盘踞千年的妖主——白狼妖王。
妖王目光冷冽扫过四人，带着几分睥睨轻蔑，嗤然冷笑：“原来是下凡历劫的四方神君。骨妖王那等无能之辈，守不住方寸迷阵，折在你们手里，实属庸碌。今日本座在此，倒要看看，尔等凡身仙胎，能有几分能耐。”
张忠东素来嫉恶如仇，听闻妖物狂妄出言，顿时怒不可遏，厉声呵斥：“妖孽休得猖狂！你盘踞密林，炼化毒瘴，残害过路生灵，阻塞西行救世之路，罪孽滔天！今日我等便替天行道，斩你妖身，除此一方祸患！”
白狼妖王仰天狂笑，声震林樾：“替天行道？就凭尔等未复仙基的凡胎！”
笑声未歇，妖王手臂一挥，手中毒牙长枪骤然横扫，枪尖萦绕的紫黑瘴气化作滔天毒浪，裹挟腥风煞气，铺天盖地朝着四人碾压而来，势如洪峰，无可阻挡。
王学南不敢怠慢，立时催动玄武灵伞，伞面灵光暴涨，化作厚重玄色光罩稳稳撑开，硬挡毒浪冲击。毒瘴撞在灵光之上，滋滋腐蚀作响，黑气翻涌不休，灵伞屏障层层动荡、明暗不定，王学南面色渐显苍白，体内神力急速耗损，勉力支撑，不敢有丝毫松懈。
少许毒瘴绕过屏障缝隙悄然渗入，刚及四人身周，宁洋北立时催动青木灵气化作清光流转周身，将侵入的毒氛一一化解，眉宇间已然多了几分凝重：“此妖瘴气阴毒至极，耗神蚀力，不可与之久耗缠斗，速布四方镇妖阵，借天帝仙威，合力困杀！”
content_en:
After leaving the old ruins of Huangsha, the four gods, carrying the Emperor of Heaven's zephyr, traveled west hand in hand. After walking for several miles, the terrain suddenly sank, and there was an ancient forest in front of us, called the Lost Soul Forest.
The ancient trees in the forest are towering, their branches are entangled, and the sun is blocked by thick shade. Even during the day, it is as dark as night. The damp and filthy atmosphere in the forest lingers, with rotten leaves and branches piled up layer by layer, and a faint purple miasma rising from the gaps between the grass and rocks, overflowing with the wind. This miasma causes burning pain and bone-piercing pain when it touches the skin, and causes dizziness and confusion when it enters the nose. It is comparable to the poisonous mist of an unusual mountain mist. It is clearly the result of a monster that has been entrenched for many years, using its own demonic essence to combine with the vicious aura of the dead souls in the barren tomb. It is sinister and treacherous, enough to trap immortals and confuse gods.
Ning Yangbei stopped and gathered his thoughts, his brows slightly condensed. The aura of green wood around his body circulated leisurely, protecting his meridians and soul, and said slowly: "The poisonous miasma in this forest corrodes the bones and disturbs people's will. It is definitely not a natural turbid air. There must be a big demon lurking in the forest, taking advantage of the miasma to set up dangers, intercept and kill travelers, and cause harm to all directions."
Wang Xuenan lowered his eyes and pinched his fingers to deduce the hexagram. He raised his head for a moment with a solemn expression: "The Lost Soul Forest is a famous dangerous pass in the Western Wilderness. The miasma in the forest condenses the power of demons for thousands of years. If it touches the miasma, the soul will shake and the cultivation will collapse. Looking at the dense momentum of the miasma, the demons in the forest are deep and powerful. They are still more powerful than the previous Bone Demon King. Don't underestimate the enemy."
Chen Xuexi pressed the sharp white tiger blade around his waist tightly, his body stood like a pine, his eyes were as cold as cold stars, penetrating through the layers of purple miasma, peering directly into the darkness of the heart of the forest, and said in a deep voice: "The monster hides in the miasma, hides its head and tail, and only dares to use poison to plot, which is not the right path of demon cultivation. If you have the ability, you will show your body. If you fight in person, there is no need to be sneaky."
Zhang Zhongdong held the flaming spiritual staff in his hand. The red bird holy fire leaped faintly at the tip of the staff. A wisp of flames spit out, and the poisonous miasma around him melted when it encountered fire. He had a strong temperament and said with great enthusiasm: "We are destined to save the world, and we are blessed by the power of the Emperor of Heaven. Why should we be afraid of the poisonous miasma in the forest! We can simply go straight into the dense forest, cut off the root of the evil, and clear the way forward for the westward journey."
Ning Yangbei nodded slightly and made up his mind: "The miasma is extremely poisonous and spreads indefinitely. It must not be dispersed. I use the vitality and fresh air of green wood to surround the four people, protect the soul meridians and isolate the poisonous invasion; learn from Nanzhan Xuan The Wu Ling Umbrella sticks to the surrounding barrier to block the turbulent flow of the miasma; Zhongdong uses the sacred fire of the Suzaku to clear the way, burning the miasma to clear the way; he follows the example of traveling to the west, guarding against surprise attacks by monsters in the dark, and the four of them follow each other step by step, advancing and retreating together. "
When the three of them heard the words, they all obeyed their orders solemnly. They immediately kept their positions and slowly walked into the Forest of Lost Souls.
The further you go deeper into the forest, the darker the sky becomes and the purple miasma becomes more intense. The scenery five steps away is completely obscured by the mist, making it difficult to distinguish the mountains, rocks, grass and trees. There was a dead silence in the forest. There was no chirping of birds or insects. Only the soft sound of the four people stepping on rotten leaves was particularly clear in the silence.
Suddenly, I heard a wolf howl deep in the forest. It was shrill and desolate, cracking through the forest and mist, echoing in the valley. Before the howl ended, the vegetation in the forest rustled and swayed, and a strong fishy wind blew towards the face, carrying a poisonous miasma. Dozens of gray and dark shadows rushed out from the purple mist. They looked like wolves, walking upright, with white fangs exposed, eyes glowing with a faint green light, and traces of poisonous miasma lingering in their fur. They were poisonous wolf demons that had been infiltrated by the evil spirits in the forest all year round.
The group of wolf monsters showed a fierce look in their eyes, bared their teeth and roared. Without a moment's hesitation, they bared their teeth and claws and rushed towards the four of them. The tips of their claws were filled with miasma poison, and they struck directly at the vital parts of their throats. They were fierce and arrogant, and fearless of death.
When Chen Xuexi saw this, he didn't wait for the monster to get close. His body suddenly flew out like an arrow from a string. The white tiger's sharp blade unsheathed with a sound, and the cold light cut through the miasma. His body movements are swift and erratic, he shuttles between the wolves, not greedy for more kills, and each knife hits the key joints of the wolf monster's head with precision. As the blade light rose and fell, several of the poisonous wolf monsters that rushed forward collapsed, their muscles and bones shattered, and they could no longer jump.
However, there were a large number of wolf demons, and they followed one after another without any fear. The remaining demons bypassed Chen Xuexi and pounced on the three people protected by the Xuanwu Spirit Umbrella. The poisonous claws scratched on the spiritual light barrier one after another, making a dull impact sound, and the spiritual light of the spiritual umbrella fluctuated in brightness and trembled faintly.
Upon seeing this, Zhang Zhongdong was unwilling to let the monsters besiege him., immediately waved the flame wand, and the blazing Suzaku Holy Fire rushed out, turning into a continuous wave of fire and sweeping away. The holy fire is the yang energy of heaven and earth. It is specially designed to defeat evil monsters. Wherever the fire wave passes, the miasma around the body of the close wolf monster is instantly burned away, and the body screams with anxiety.
But after the monster's body fell to the ground, black and purple poisonous blood overflowed from the wound and seeped into the forest soil. In an instant, it evaporated and turned into a thicker miasma. The surrounding poisonous atmosphere became more intense, and it had the potential to surround and wrap the four people.
Upon seeing this, Wang Xuenan quickly shouted a warning: "Don't kill wantonly! The poisonous blood of this monster corpse can nourish the miasma. The more we kill, the more the miasma will grow. If we are trapped for a long time, we will be trapped by the poisonous miasma, and the gain will not be worth the loss!"
Ning Yangbei immediately issued an order in a deep voice: "Learn from the West and be loyal to the East. Immediately withdraw your troops and retreat. Enter the formation and defend. For the time being, avoid their sharp edges and don't hurt the wolves again."
After hearing the order, the two men immediately sheathed their swords and suppressed the fire. Their bodies swayed back into the protective shield of the spiritual umbrella, and they concentrated on alert. Seeing that the four people no longer took the initiative to attack, the group of wolf demons did not dare to attack rashly. They only surrounded the edge of the miasma from a distance, bared their teeth and growled, guarding the main road in the forest, as if they were guarding the door for the big demon in the forest.
After a moment of stalemate, a cold laughter suddenly came from the depths of the dense forest. The sound was like a wolf's howl mixed with human words. It was so rude and domineering that it shook all the branches and leaves in the forest: "Who is this junior god king? He doesn't know the heights of the sky and the earth. He dares to break into this forest of souls without permission, and he dares to hurt the wolves under my command. He is really impatient!"
Where the laughter fell, the dense purple miasma slowly parted to both sides, and a burly figure slowly stepped out of the mist.
The person who came had the head of a wolf, his whole body was covered with long gray and black hair, his shoulders and back were bulging, his body was powerful and terrifying, his white fangs protruded from the corners of his lips, and his eyes were glowing green. He wore heavy armor made of animal bones, and held a long-tusked spear in his hand. Purple-black poisonous miasma lingered around the tip of the spear. It is the demon lord who has been in Luohun Forest for thousands of years - the White Wolf Demon King.
The demon king glanced at the four of them coldly, with a hint of scorn and contempt, and sneered: "It turns out that he is the god king of the four directions who has descended to earth and experienced calamities. Incompetent people like the bone demon king can't hold on to the small formation, and they are in your hands. They are really mediocre. I am here today, and I want to see how capable you mortal immortals are."
Zhang Zhongdong has always been jealous of evil. When he heard the monster's arrogant words, he became furious and shouted: "Don't let the monster be so rampant! You are entrenched in the dense forest, refining the poisonous miasma, killing the passing creatures, and blocking the way to the west to save the world. Your sins are heinous! Today we will act on behalf of heaven and kill your monster body to eliminate this disaster!"
The White Wolf Demon King looked up to the sky and laughed wildly, the sound shocking Lin Yue: "Walking for heaven? Just because you are a mortal who has not regained your immortality!"
Before the laughter stopped, the demon king waved his arm, and the poison-toothed spear in his hand suddenly swept across. The purple-black miasma lingering at the tip of the spear turned into a monstrous wave of poison, carrying the fishy wind and evil aura, overwhelming the sky and crushing towards the four people. It was like a torrent, unstoppable.
Wang Xuenan did not dare to neglect, and immediately activated the Xuanwu Spiritual Umbrella. The aura on the umbrella surface surged, turning into a thick black light shield that opened steadily, blocking the impact of the poisonous wave. The poisonous miasma collided with the spiritual light, sizzling and corroding, the black energy surged endlessly, and the spiritual umbrella barrier was turbulent and light and dark. Wang Xuenan's face gradually turned pale, and the divine power in his body was rapidly depleted. He struggled to hold on and did not dare to relax at all.
A small amount of poisonous miasma sneaked in by bypassing the cracks in the barrier, and as soon as it reached the four people, Ning Yangbei immediately activated the green wood spiritual energy to turn into clear light and flow around him, eliminating the invading poisonous atmosphere one by one. There was already a bit of solemnity between his eyebrows: "This demonic miasma is extremely sinister and consumes the power of the gods. You cannot fight with it for a long time. Quickly deploy the demon-suppressing array in all directions, and use the power of the Emperor of Heaven to trap and kill!"
